objective: Map Plaid Link token creation flow and identify required parameters
findings_summary: Link token creation requires client_id, secret, user.client_user_id, products array, and country_codes. Returns a link_token valid for 4 hours.

response.body_summary: API reference page for POST /link/token/create endpoint

observation.what_happened: Read API documentation for the /link/token/create endpoint. Found complete parameter list and response schema.
observation.what_learned: Link token creation is the entry point for Plaid Link. Requires client_id, secret, user object with client_user_id, products array, and country_codes. Returns link_token (string, 4hr TTL), expiration timestamp, and request_id.
observation.surprises: Token has a 4-hour TTL — shorter than expected for an initialization token
questions_raised: Can link_token be refreshed without creating a new one?
What happens when products array is empty?

response.body_summary: Returns link_token string and expiration timestamp

observation.what_happened: Successfully created a link token in sandbox environment. Response returned in ~200ms with link_token, expiration (4 hours from now), and request_id.
observation.what_learned: Sandbox link token creation works with minimal required fields. The expiration is exactly 4 hours from creation time. Rate limiting headers not present in sandbox.
questions_raised: Does production have rate limiting headers?
What is the rate limit for this endpoint?

postconditions: Have valid link_token for Plaid Link initialization

findings.title: Plaid Link token creation requires 5 mandatory fields
findings.description: The /link/token/create endpoint requires client_id, secret, user.client_user_id, products (non-empty array), and country_codes. Returns a link_token with 4-hour TTL. This is the mandatory entry point for all Plaid Link flows — no alternative initialization path exists.
